proposals.title: Yak airframe bright N/R breakup
proposals.change: Add a restrained light-gray normal and roughness breakup pass to the Yak airframe base material, keeping the existing bright unlit HF response intact.
proposals.implementation_notes: Blend imported micro-normal and roughness variation at low amplitude; clamp albedo and maintain a bright neutral material floor.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Small unlit variation remains within the L52 HF FOV band and cannot introduce dark PBR-only regions.
proposals.acceptance_test: All 11 cameras remain Usable; YakBeauty and PropNose show visible panel breakup without any new near-black airframe patch.

proposals.title: Airframe panel seam dirt accents
proposals.change: Add thin, low-contrast dirt accents along existing airframe panel seams using the airframe material's AO and dirt channels.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use masked seam data with a narrow width and warm-gray tint; keep the effect localized to existing seams and below the base-value collapse threshold.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Only existing seam pixels are modified, with no broad darkening or added geometry.
proposals.acceptance_test: Prop and YakBeauty retain Usable status and seam accents are readable at capture resolution without turning panels into dark bands.

proposals.title: Airframe rivet glint control
proposals.change: Introduce subtle bright roughness breaks around selected rivet rows to increase edge and surface uniqueness.
proposals.implementation_notes: Drive a sparse mask from existing rivet placement; brighten only the response, not the base color, and suppress the mask outside close airframe surfaces.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Sparse response-only variation is additive to the frozen HF look and avoids a global metallic or albedo change.
proposals.acceptance_test: Rivet rows gain readable separation in PropNose and Cockpit while no camera loses Usable status.

proposals.title: Wing-root grime crescent
proposals.change: Add one narrow, warm-gray grime crescent at the existing wing-root contact area.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use an AO-driven mask with a soft falloff and limited opacity; do not extend the accent across the full wing or fuselage.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single small contact accent creates local structure without adding a large hero stack or darkening the silhouette.
proposals.acceptance_test: YakBeauty remains Usable and the wing-root contact reads as a localized material transition rather than a black seam.

proposals.title: Airframe dirt gradient
proposals.change: Add a very low-opacity lower-surface dirt gradient to the visible fuselage and wing materials.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use world-space or existing UV orientation to place the gradient only below the midline; keep the tint desaturated tan-gray and preserve the existing bright HF base.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The change is a shallow tonal gradient with a high luminance floor and no new opaque content.
proposals.acceptance_test: Both target cameras remain Usable; lower surfaces gain separation while the main airframe silhouette stays bright and readable.

proposals.title: Prop disc radial readability
proposals.change: Tune M_PropDisc with a restrained radial roughness and brightness variation so the rotating disc reads as a coherent translucent motion surface.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a soft radial mask with a bright center-to-edge response; avoid hard rings, dark radial wedges, and opaque blade-like bands.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The modification stays on the existing prop disc material and preserves the L52 unlit HF motion treatment.
proposals.acceptance_test: Prop and PropNose remain Usable; the disc reads at a glance with no new black spokes or distracting concentric artifacts.

proposals.title: Prop hub center contrast
proposals.change: Add a small additive warm-neutral hub highlight and surrounding roughness ring to improve prop-disc center readability.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a tiny masked emissive proxy centered on the existing hub; keep intensity below bloom threshold and use a neutral brass-gray color rather than saturated light.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The proxy is small, additive, and limited to the existing hub center, so it cannot create a broad dark material response.
proposals.acceptance_test: PropHub and Prop remain Usable; the center of the disc is distinct without visible bloom washout.

proposals.title: Prop blade-root wear marks
proposals.change: Add two small translucent wear marks at the existing prop blade roots using a light desaturated metal tint.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place the marks inside the current disc mask and keep their opacity low enough that they read as material variation rather than frozen blade geometry.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The accents are confined to existing prop-disc pixels and retain the frozen motion-blur treatment.
proposals.acceptance_test: PropNose remains Usable; blade-root regions show subtle wear without breaking disc continuity.

proposals.title: Rifle tan value breakup
proposals.change: Add fine warm and pale tan albedo variation to M_RifleTan so the rifle body reads as worn canvas-coated metal rather than a uniform block.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a low-frequency mottled mask with restrained contrast; keep the average value near the existing tan and do not introduce a dark sole material.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Only the existing tan rifle material changes, with average luminance preserved for the frozen ADS composition.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable and the rifle body has visible tonal variation without losing its tan identity.

proposals.title: Rifle worn edge pass
proposals.change: Add narrow pale wear highlights to the rifle's existing outer edges and grip corners.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a curvature or existing edge mask with low opacity and warm ivory-tan response; exclude broad flat faces and muzzle openings.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The change is edge-localized, bright-biased, and does not alter the dark-value structure of the weapon silhouette.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; grip, receiver, and stock edges gain readable wear with no clipped highlights.

proposals.title: Rifle recess dirt pinstripes
proposals.change: Add thin brown-gray dirt lines to the rifle's existing receiver recesses and seam breaks.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a masked dirt channel with narrow widths and soft antialiasing; clamp the dirt value above the black-collapse range.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The dirt is confined to pre-existing recesses and remains a small contrast cue inside the frozen ADS FOV.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable and recesses separate at capture size without appearing as painted black stripes.

proposals.title: Rifle metal-neutral hardware
proposals.change: Give exposed rifle hardware a restrained neutral-metal roughness response while leaving the tan body unchanged.
proposals.implementation_notes: Mask only existing hardware islands; use medium gray response with controlled roughness and no black metallic albedo.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The hardware mask is small and bright-neutral, avoiding dark PBR-only FOV treatment.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains Usable; hardware reads as distinct worn metal while the tan stock and receiver remain visually dominant.

proposals.title: Behind-wall rust tile
proposals.change: Add one small rust tile decal/material variation behind the wall on a visible city-side construction surface.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place at x>=bx+3 on an existing wall or utility surface; use a compact orange-brown rust mask with a light base and no foreground overlap.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The authored weathering is explicitly behind the wall and outside the frozen foreground densify band.
proposals.acceptance_test: City remains Usable; the rust tile is visible only on the intended rear surface and does not affect Prop, YakBeauty, Ocean, or Wide.

proposals.title: Behind-wall salt-rust streak
proposals.change: Add a narrow vertical salt-and-rust streak to a rear harbor wall or piling.
proposals.implementation_notes: Constrain placement to x>=bx+3 and use a pale salt edge around a muted rust center; keep the tile small enough to remain a background accent.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Rear-only placement prevents interaction with the L52 foreground HF silhouette and preserves ocean/sky balance.
proposals.acceptance_test: Harbor remains Usable; the streak reads as a small environmental material cue with no foreground contamination.

proposals.title: Behind-wall dirt tile variation
proposals.change: Introduce a compact desaturated dirt tile on a rear concrete or masonry surface.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use one shared imported dirt texture with a light-gray base, low-frequency breakup, and limited opacity; place each instance at x>=bx+3.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Both accents are tiny rear surfaces and cannot create broad dark regions in the protected cameras.
proposals.acceptance_test: City and Harbor remain Usable; rear material repetition is reduced without any foreground change.

proposals.title: Airframe contact AO restraint
proposals.change: Tune the airframe AO contribution to strengthen contact definition while clamping the darkest output to the current L52 floor.
proposals.implementation_notes: Reduce AO radius and remap its minimum value upward; apply only to existing panel contacts and attachment points.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: This is a bounded shader remap designed specifically to prevent black collapse while preserving panel separation.
proposals.acceptance_test: PropNose and YakBeauty remain Usable; contacts become clearer and the darkest sampled airframe values do not decrease from L52.

proposals.title: Airframe roughness fleck pass
proposals.change: Add sparse micro-roughness flecks to the airframe metal without changing its base color or metallic level.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a high-frequency imported mask at low amplitude and keep the response broad enough to avoid noisy aliasing in the capture.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Response-only variation is small, high-frequency, and keeps the L52 unlit HF value structure unchanged.
proposals.acceptance_test: Prop and YakBeauty remain Usable; flecks are visible as controlled surface breakup rather than shimmer or dark noise.

proposals.title: Behind-wall painted metal chips
proposals.change: Add a small cluster of pale paint chips over muted rust on one rear metal panel.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single compact mask at x>=bx+3; keep chips off the ground plane and use pale gray edges so the panel does not become a dark mass.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The weathering is rear-only, small in area, and value-balanced toward pale chipped paint.
proposals.acceptance_test: Harbor remains Usable; the rear panel gains readable paint loss without any new foreground or ocean contrast issue.

proposals.title: Subtle airframe heat stain
proposals.change: Add a small pale amber-gray heat stain near an existing engine or exhaust-adjacent airframe panel.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a tiny masked additive proxy with low intensity and no bloom; keep the stain localized and lighter than the surrounding airframe rather than dark soot.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The accent is additive, tiny, bright-biased, and does not introduce a dark PBR surface into the FOV.
proposals.acceptance_test: YakBeauty remains Usable; the heat-stain cue is visible without bloom, washout, or loss of airframe readability.

proposals.title: Protected wide-view material balance
proposals.change: Apply a final shared material clamp to M_L21_* and M_L23_* weathering layers so dirt and rust contributions cannot lower protected surfaces below the L52 luminance floor.
proposals.implementation_notes: Clamp only the new weathering contribution on rear surfaces at x>=bx+3; preserve sky, water, foreground HF, and existing base material values.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The guard applies only to behind-wall weathering and explicitly protects the wide environmental value structure.
proposals.acceptance_test: All 11 cameras remain Usable; City and Ocean retain stable sky/water values, and no protected camera shows a uniqueness or black-value collapse.

proposals.title: Yak fuselage panel seam accents
proposals.change: Add three thin, warm-gray unlit seam strips to the Yak fuselage panel breaks behind the wall.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep strips narrow, low-contrast, and at x>=bx+3; use unlit HF shading with no dark metal response.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Behind-wall placement preserves the frozen foreground silhouette and avoids PBR, sun, sky, and black-value changes.
proposals.acceptance_test: Capture Loop52 and confirm 11/11 cameras remain usable; YakBeauty gains visible panel segmentation without new dark regions.

proposals.title: Yak wing-root hatch outline
proposals.change: Add one small rounded-rectangle hatch outline at the visible wing root behind the wall.

proposals.capture_safe_reason: The accent is a tiny behind-wall surface detail and cannot alter the frozen aircraft silhouette or global exposure.
proposals.acceptance_test: Verify the hatch reads at beauty distance while Prop, PropNose, City, Ocean, and Wide remain visually unchanged and usable.

proposals.title: Fuselage access-panel offset
proposals.change: Add one shallow offset border around an existing fuselage access panel behind the wall.

proposals.capture_safe_reason: Only a small existing-surface border is added beyond x>=bx+3, with no new dark or reflective material.
proposals.acceptance_test: Panel border must be legible in YakBeauty and absent from the frozen foreground overlap; all 11 cameras remain usable.

proposals.title: Bright prop-hub shell

proposals.implementation_notes: Use a small additive emissive proxy with low intensity and warm ivory color; keep it tightly fitted to the existing hub.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Small additive geometry improves hub readability without dark PBR, silhouette expansion, or lighting changes.
proposals.acceptance_test: PropHub and PropNose must show a readable bright center with no bloom washout; Prop, YakBeauty, and the remaining cameras stay usable.

proposals.title: Prop-blade leading-edge shells
proposals.change: Add two narrow bright leading-edge proxy strips to the propeller blades.

proposals.capture_safe_reason: The additive strips are thin, localized, and bright enough to avoid black blade collapse without becoming a hero silhouette change.
proposals.acceptance_test: Blade edges read as separate bright shells in Prop and PropNose; no washout, oversized glow, or usability loss occurs in any camera.

proposals.title: Hub bolt-ring HF dots
proposals.change: Add a small ring of warm-gray high-frequency bolt dots around the prop hub.

proposals.capture_safe_reason: The dots add controlled local frequency with no lighting, dark-metal, or silhouette impact.
proposals.acceptance_test: The hub ring is visible in PropHub at capture resolution and does not create a dark plate or reduce usability in Prop or PropNose.

proposals.title: Cockpit tub rim highlight

proposals.capture_safe_reason: The rim stays behind x>=bx+3 and uses restrained unlit values, improving cockpit structure without changing the aircraft outline.
proposals.acceptance_test: Cockpit shows a distinct tub boundary while YakBeauty and all other frozen views remain 11/11 usable.

proposals.title: Instrument cluster bezel breakup
proposals.change: Add two thin bezel-divider strips to split the instrument cluster into readable gauge groups.

proposals.capture_safe_reason: Only two narrow behind-wall dividers are added, with no glass darkening, emissive bloom, or global material changes.
proposals.acceptance_test: Gauge group separation reads in Cockpit and ADS without black instrument collapse; all 11 cameras remain usable.

proposals.title: Instrument needle pinpoints
proposals.change: Add tiny additive emissive pinpoints for the primary gauge needles.

proposals.capture_safe_reason: The proxies are additive, tiny, and localized, preventing black gauge faces without affecting aircraft silhouette or exposure.
proposals.acceptance_test: Needle accents are readable but do not bloom or wash out; Cockpit and ADS stay usable and the other nine cameras remain unchanged.

proposals.title: Throttle quadrant plane break

proposals.capture_safe_reason: The single small plane remains behind the wall and uses unlit HF values that preserve visible separation.
proposals.acceptance_test: The throttle-side structure reads as a distinct plane in Cockpit without new black mass or any camera dropping below Usable.

proposals.title: Glove cuff seam

proposals.capture_safe_reason: The cuff detail is isolated behind the wall and does not touch canopy, aircraft, or lighting materials.
proposals.acceptance_test: Cockpit gains a readable hand-to-sleeve transition with no silhouette growth and remains usable in the frozen recipe.

proposals.title: Glove knuckle plane

proposals.implementation_notes: Keep the patch soft-edged and mid-value, with no dark occlusion layer or extra volume.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single flat HF patch adds local form cues without reflective or dark material behavior and without changing the cockpit silhouette.
proposals.acceptance_test: The hand reads as a separate form in Cockpit while black-area and uniqueness metrics do not regress.

proposals.title: Glove-arm fold accent

proposals.acceptance_test: At least one fold reads in Cockpit without creating a large bright band, black patch, or camera usability regression.

proposals.title: Canopy seal cord cue

proposals.title: Canopy frame corner tabs

proposals.acceptance_test: Tabs provide two stable edge landmarks with no bloom washout or black-glass collapse; all 11 cameras remain usable.

proposals.title: Canopy latch highlight

proposals.title: Gunner station bulkhead ribs

proposals.title: Gunner station trim notch

proposals.title: Cockpit anti-glare brow edge

proposals.acceptance_test: City and Ocean retain clear land-water separation and the new plaster patch is visible only as a small secondary accent.

proposals.title: Apartment corrugated service strip
proposals.change: Add one narrow bright corrugated service strip to apartment_midrise_proxy.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a short vertical strip at x~=bx+1/+2 with pale galvanized value and low-frequency ribbing for readable edge separation.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The strip is small, bright, and unlit HF-compatible with the frozen city pass.
proposals.acceptance_test: City shows a single readable corrugated detail with no material washout and unchanged camera usability.

proposals.title: Crane counterweight safety stripe
proposals.change: Add one short yellow safety stripe to the counterweight of harbor_crane_proxy.
proposals.implementation_notes: Restrict the stripe to the existing counterweight face and use a soft additive value that remains below highlight clipping.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: One short additive stripe is a low-area recognition cue and does not alter the crane silhouette mass.
proposals.acceptance_test: Harbor shows the stripe as a distinct safety color without bloom, sun washout, or loss of usable framing.

proposals.title: Ship deckhouse bright trim
proposals.change: Add a small pale trim strip around the upper deckhouse of container_ship_proxy.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place the trim at x>=bx+3 and limit it to the upper deckhouse outline; avoid adding a full bright hull or container stack.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The small authored trim is behind the wall and cannot compromise the frozen foreground composition.
proposals.acceptance_test: Harbor and Wide gain deckhouse separation with no new dark mass and no camera dropping below Usable.

proposals.title: Foam fleck cluster at seawall outlet
proposals.change: Add a sparse cluster of five small off-white foam flecks where seawall_proxy meets the water.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep flecks low, separated, and slightly warm; cap opacity and emissive intensity so the cluster reads as foam rather than a white bar.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Sparse additive flecks are tiny, localized, and preserve both ocean color variation and the approved HF density.
proposals.acceptance_test: Harbor and Ocean show a localized foam contact cue with no pure-black ocean, white clipping, or usability regression.

proposals.title: Rifle Receiver Edge Stripe
proposals.change: Add a narrow pale HF stripe along the rifle receiver top edge to clarify the ADS silhouette.
proposals.implementation_notes: Reuse the existing L52 unlit checker/stripe family; keep stripe width below 2% of receiver width and avoid dark fill changes.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Small additive HF treatment preserves the frozen ADS checkers/stripes and does not introduce a dark sole FOV material.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS remains usable with the receiver contour readable and the existing HF checker/stripe pattern visibly intact.

proposals.title: Iron Sight Front Post Highlight
proposals.change: Add a thin high-frequency light facet to the rifle iron-sight front post for immediate sight alignment.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place only on the upper front-post face; use a light neutral value with no dark metallic replacement.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The change is confined to a tiny sight-post facet and cannot wash out the broader weapon or sky.
proposals.acceptance_test: The front post is separable from the rear sight at ADS capture distance without losing existing stripes.

proposals.title: Barrel Crown Ring Cue
proposals.change: Add one thin light ring around the visible barrel crown to establish barrel direction in ADS.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single narrow ring only at the crown; keep the underlying barrel material and L52 HF pattern unchanged.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single thin ring is a bounded HF delta with no large silhouette or exposure change.
proposals.acceptance_test: Barrel axis is readable in ADS and the crown ring does not merge into a solid dark block.

proposals.title: Glove Trigger-Guard Contact Band
proposals.change: Add a small light contact band where the glove meets the trigger guard.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a low-intensity warm-neutral emissive mask limited to the contact seam; do not outline the full glove.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The emissive proxy is tiny, localized, and additive, so it preserves weapon HF structure and avoids dark material replacement.
proposals.acceptance_test: Contact seam reads at ADS resolution without producing a halo wider than the trigger guard.

proposals.title: Glove Thumb Contact Notch
proposals.change: Add one small pale notch at the glove thumb-to-receiver contact point.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place a single masked proxy at the contact point with very low emissive intensity and no full-hand tracing.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Only one tiny additive contact cue changes, leaving glove and rifle base values untouched.
proposals.acceptance_test: Thumb contact is distinguishable from the receiver while the glove remains visually subordinate to the ADS sight picture.

proposals.title: Rear Sight Aperture Interior
proposals.change: Add a small light interior rim to the rear iron-sight aperture.
proposals.implementation_notes: Treat only the aperture rim with a neutral unlit material; leave the aperture center open and retain the existing HF stripes nearby.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The aperture rim is a small bounded feature and cannot create broad washout or black collapse.
proposals.acceptance_test: Rear aperture remains open and the rim improves sight readability without filling the sight with solid light.

proposals.title: Igla Launcher Recognition Band
proposals.change: Add one thin light recognition band around the Igla proxy body.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single offset band with a muted warm-neutral value; avoid full-body recoloring or dark PBR treatment.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The band is a thin HF identifier on the existing proxy and does not alter the broader ADS background.
proposals.acceptance_test: Igla proxy is identifiable as a separate launcher component at ADS capture scale without band bloom.

proposals.title: Igla Nose-Cap Direction Marker
proposals.change: Add a short pale marker on the Igla nose cap to clarify its forward direction.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a small masked emissive dash on the nose cap only; keep intensity below the strongest existing HF stripe.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The cue is a tiny additive dash and cannot replace the ADS HF densify or affect unrelated cameras.
proposals.acceptance_test: Igla forward direction is readable and the marker remains localized with no bloom over the sight picture.

proposals.title: Bolt-Handle Separation Tick
proposals.change: Add a single light separation tick at the rifle bolt-handle junction.
proposals.implementation_notes: Restrict the tick to the junction seam and use a light neutral value; do not expand the bolt silhouette.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: One small seam marker adds edge information while preserving all existing weapon masses and HF stripes.
proposals.acceptance_test: Bolt handle and receiver read as separate forms without creating a new high-contrast focal hotspot.

proposals.title: Glove Knuckle Facet Pair
proposals.change: Add two small light facets to the glove knuckles nearest the rifle contact zone.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use two separated facets only, with mid-light neutral values; preserve the glove base and avoid a full hand outline.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The facets occupy a small glove area and add HF breakup without darkening or flattening the ADS composition.
proposals.acceptance_test: Glove knuckle volume is readable and facets do not connect into a continuous contour line.

proposals.title: Front Sight Base Corner Mark
proposals.change: Add one light corner mark to the front sight base where it meets the barrel.
proposals.implementation_notes: Limit the treatment to one upper corner and keep it behind the existing front-post highlight in value hierarchy.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The corner mark is a single small HF feature and does not modify any large material region.
proposals.acceptance_test: Front sight base separates from the barrel in ADS without obscuring the front post.

proposals.title: Rifle Rail Slot Rhythm
proposals.change: Add three short pale slot dashes on the visible top rail.
proposals.implementation_notes: Reuse the L52 checker/stripe language with three non-contiguous dashes; preserve spacing and avoid a continuous bright rail.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The dashes reinforce the frozen HF language and remain small, sparse, and unlit.
proposals.acceptance_test: Rail perspective and weapon orientation improve while the original checker/stripe field remains visible between dashes.

proposals.title: Igla Grip Contact Pin
proposals.change: Add one tiny emissive pin at the glove-to-Igla grip contact.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single low-intensity pin-sized proxy at the grip seam; no finger tracing or launcher recolor.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The pin is a minimal additive contact cue, preserving the rest of the Igla and glove values.
proposals.acceptance_test: Hand placement on the Igla grip is clear at ADS scale and the pin does not read as a muzzle or indicator light.

proposals.title: Muzzle Device Vent Notches
proposals.change: Add two light notches to the visible muzzle-device vents.
proposals.implementation_notes: Treat only two vent faces with small neutral unlit patches; keep the muzzle body unchanged and avoid emissive bloom.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Two small vent cues add barrel detail without creating broad contrast or changing the frozen HF background.
proposals.acceptance_test: Muzzle device reads as a distinct form and vents remain separated rather than becoming a bright bar.

proposals.title: Glove Wrist Cuff Break
proposals.change: Add one short light break across the glove cuff nearest the rifle.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use one diagonal cuff segment with restrained neutral value; keep it discontinuous and away from the full glove silhouette.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single cuff segment supplies material separation without adding a large authored hero surface.
proposals.acceptance_test: Glove cuff location is readable and the segment does not merge with the rifle rail stripes.

proposals.title: Sight-Line Alignment Marker
proposals.change: Add one short additive marker connecting the rear aperture axis to the front post axis.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a segmented, low-intensity dash rather than a continuous line; keep total length below one-third of the sight gap.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The marker is a small additive proxy that reinforces sight direction without replacing the iron-sight geometry or HF stripes.
proposals.acceptance_test: The sight axis is easier to follow while the marker remains segmented and does not dominate the weapon frame.

proposals.title: Igla Tube Hatch Corner
proposals.change: Add one pale corner facet to the Igla tube hatch for component readability.
proposals.implementation_notes: Apply the facet to one hatch corner only; keep it mid-light and separate from the existing recognition band.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The tiny facet is localized to the Igla proxy and cannot cause broad washout or camera-wide uniqueness collapse.
proposals.acceptance_test: Igla hatch location reads as a separate component without turning the tube into a solid light shape.

proposals.title: Trigger Finger Contact Sliver
proposals.change: Add a narrow light sliver at the glove trigger-finger contact point.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single masked sliver shorter than the trigger width and keep emissive intensity below the existing sight accents.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The proxy is tiny, additive, and contact-specific, with no material replacement on the glove or trigger guard.
proposals.acceptance_test: Trigger-finger placement is recognizable without producing a bright continuous trigger outline.

proposals.title: Iron-Sight Rear Shoulder Edge
proposals.change: Add one light shoulder edge on the rear iron-sight housing to separate it from the receiver.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place a single narrow facet on the housing shoulder; keep the receiver stripes visible and avoid a full housing outline.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: One restrained edge facet improves separation while retaining the frozen unlit HF densify treatment.
proposals.acceptance_test: Rear sight housing separates from the receiver in ADS without closing the aperture or increasing black area.

proposals.title: Barrel-to-Glove Overlap Tick
proposals.change: Add one small neutral emissive tick at the barrel-to-glove overlap to clarify depth ordering.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use one sub-centimeter-equivalent screen-space cue at the overlap seam, with low intensity and no silhouette extension.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The change is an isolated additive seam cue and leaves all broader camera compositions untouched.
proposals.acceptance_test: Barrel depth ordering against the glove is readable at ADS capture resolution with no bloom or silhouette jump.

proposals.title: Compact twin-lobed muzzle flash
proposals.change: Add a short-duration, camera-facing twin-lobed muzzle flash proxy to the primary aircraft gun firing point.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a small additive sprite or card, warm white core with restrained amber edge, 0.05-0.09 second lifetime, and bounded size relative to the weapon muzzle.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Small additive emissive content stays in the muzzle region and cannot create a dark FOV wall or sun-washout field.
proposals.acceptance_test: Capture Combat and ADS; muzzle flash is readable for one burst, occupies less than 3 percent of frame area, and all 11 cameras remain Usable.

proposals.title: Muzzle flash pulse ring
proposals.change: Add one thin emissive pulse ring expanding from the gun muzzle during firing.
proposals.implementation_notes: Drive ring scale and opacity over a sub-0.12-second curve; keep the ring narrow and below full-frame bloom thresholds.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The effect is localized to a single small emissive contour and adds no opaque or dark geometry.
proposals.acceptance_test: Verify the ring reads as a firing cue without obscuring the nose silhouette or crossing more than 5 percent of the image width.

proposals.title: Thin gun smoke ribbon
proposals.change: Add a sparse, pale-gray gun smoke ribbon trailing briefly behind the muzzle after firing.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use translucent pale gray with low opacity, narrow ribbon width, short 0.3-0.5-second lifetime, and no volumetric wall behavior.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Pale, low-opacity additive smoke avoids the prohibited dark smoke wall while preserving aircraft silhouette visibility.
proposals.acceptance_test: Smoke remains visibly thin, never fills a central quadrant, and does not reduce contrast on Prop, PropNose, YakBeauty, City, Ocean, or Wide.

proposals.title: Gun smoke puffs
proposals.change: Add two small separated post-shot smoke puffs at the muzzle exit.
proposals.implementation_notes: Spawn no more than two puffs per shot, use pale neutral gray, low opacity, and staggered scale curves so the effect remains airy and localized.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Separated small puffs add event detail without forming an opaque mass or dark silhouette blocker.
proposals.acceptance_test: In the Combat capture, each puff is distinct, remains within 1.5 muzzle lengths, and leaves the background and aircraft readable.

proposals.title: Directional hit spark fan
proposals.change: Add a short directional fan of bright hit sparks at the aircraft impact point.
proposals.implementation_notes: Limit each burst to 6-10 fine streaks, bias emission away from the surface, and cap brightness and length for capture stability.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Fine additive streaks are spatially bounded and create no opaque or dark coverage.
proposals.acceptance_test: Sparks read at the impact point, remain shorter than the visible fuselage width, and do not cause clipping or bloom washout.

proposals.title: Single impact ember core
proposals.change: Add one compact orange-white emissive ember core at the first hit location.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a small billboard with a brief brightness peak and fast fade; keep the radius below the local panel feature scale.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single tiny emissive point provides a stable focal cue and cannot obscure the nose or create a smoke wall.
proposals.acceptance_test: The ember is visible in PropNose and Combat, remains under 1 percent of frame area, and does not alter silhouette readability.

proposals.title: Drone explosion flash core
proposals.change: Add a compact two-stage emissive flash core for a drone destruction event.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a white-yellow core followed by a restrained orange shell, with total visible duration below 0.35 seconds and no opaque debris volume.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The explosion is a small additive focal event with bounded radius and no dark volumetric body.
proposals.acceptance_test: The flash reads as a drone event in Combat and City, stays below 4 percent of frame area, and introduces no sky washout.

proposals.title: Drone explosion ember scatter
proposals.change: Add a sparse ring of warm emissive embers after the drone explosion flash.
proposals.implementation_notes: Spawn 8-12 small embers with short lifetimes, low bloom, and a tight radial extent around the destruction point.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Sparse bright embers preserve negative space and cannot become a dark or full-frame effect.
proposals.acceptance_test: Embers are individually distinguishable, stay within two drone lengths, and do not overlap the aircraft hero silhouette excessively.

proposals.title: Low-density flak puffs
proposals.change: Add three small pale flak burst puffs along a short defensive-burst path.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep puffs small, pale gray, and separated by visible sky or ocean gaps; disable dark smoke accumulation and cap active bursts.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Separated pale accents add scale and activity without introducing a dark flak wall or broad occlusion.
proposals.acceptance_test: Three puffs remain separated in City and Combat, each under 1.5 percent of frame area, with no measurable loss of hero visibility.

proposals.title: Flak spark pinpoints
proposals.change: Add a few bright pinprick sparks inside each flak burst.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use 3-5 tiny white-orange points per burst, short lifetime, and tightly bounded spread inside existing flak positions.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Pinpoint additive sparks remain small at distance and cannot create a blocking cloud or wash out the sky.
proposals.acceptance_test: Sparks are visible as discrete points in Wide without becoming a continuous bright band or affecting City composition.

proposals.title: Prop wash crescent
proposals.change: Add a thin translucent-emissive crescent indicating prop wash behind the aircraft.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a pale blue-white crescent with low opacity and a narrow arc, aligned behind the prop hub and clipped to a compact radius.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The crescent is localized to the prop region, additive, and pale enough to avoid blackening or sky washout.
proposals.acceptance_test: Prop wash reads as a subtle airflow cue, stays behind the prop silhouette, and does not reduce hub or nose detail.

proposals.title: Prop wash filament streaks
proposals.change: Add two short emissive filament streaks following the prop wash direction.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use two narrow curved streaks with low opacity and subtle motion; place them behind the prop hub and keep their length below one hub diameter.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Two narrow additive accents increase local edge structure without forming a large airflow volume.
proposals.acceptance_test: Filaments remain behind the hub, are visible in both target cameras, and cover less than 2 percent of either frame.

proposals.title: Forward tracer pair
proposals.change: Add a pair of thin warm-white tracer streaks extending from the muzzle toward the target direction.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use two tapered lines with orange tips, short travel distance, and restrained intensity; terminate them well before broad background coverage.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Thin additive lines create directional detail while preserving the aircraft, city, ocean, and sky fields.
proposals.acceptance_test: Tracers are legible as two separate lines, remain below 8 percent of frame width, and do not cross the hero cockpit or nose focal region.

proposals.title: Single tracer tip glow
proposals.change: Add a compact emissive glow at the leading tip of the primary tracer.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use one small warm-white billboard with a fast pulse and low bloom, parented to the tracer tip rather than the camera.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The glow is a single tiny additive point and cannot create a wall, dark field, or broad washout.
proposals.acceptance_test: Tip glow is visible at the tracer head, stays below 1 percent of frame area, and does not clip against HUD-safe framing.

proposals.title: Short missile trail ribbon
proposals.change: Add a narrow pale emissive ribbon behind the missile for a short travel segment.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a pale gray-blue ribbon with a soft warm core, short maximum length, and no dark smoke component; taper opacity rapidly behind the missile.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The ribbon is thin, pale, additive, and length-limited so it cannot become a dark smoke wall or cover the wide scene.
proposals.acceptance_test: Trail reads in Combat and Wide, stays under 4 percent of frame area, and does not form a continuous horizon stripe.

proposals.title: Localized ocean spray fan
proposals.change: Add a small fan of bright ocean spray at a single near-aircraft water impact point.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use 5-8 short pale-blue-white streaks with low opacity, tightly localized footprint, and no opaque foam volume.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A compact additive spray fan enhances one water event without darkening or flattening the ocean field.
proposals.acceptance_test: Spray is localized to one impact, remains below 3 percent of frame area, and leaves the horizon and water texture readable.

proposals.title: Water splash crown
proposals.change: Add a small emissive-edged splash crown at the existing water contact point.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a low, broken crown with pale cyan highlights and transparent gaps; keep the crown radius below the local wake width.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Broken additive highlights preserve water gaps and prevent the splash from becoming a solid horizon or black mass.
proposals.acceptance_test: Crown remains low and broken, reads against the water in both cameras, and does not intersect the main aircraft silhouette.

proposals.title: Harbor splash droplets
proposals.change: Add four isolated emissive droplet streaks above a harbor splash contact.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep droplets narrow, pale blue-white, and separated; use randomized but bounded lengths and a short lifetime.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Isolated droplets add fine-scale movement without creating a dense spray field or obscuring harbor geometry.
proposals.acceptance_test: All four droplets remain individually separable, stay within one splash radius, and do not cover buildings or the aircraft.

proposals.title: Ocean spray glint points
proposals.change: Add three tiny cool-white glint points to the tops of the ocean spray particles.
proposals.implementation_notes: Parent glints to existing spray peaks, keep their intensity below sun-disc levels, and use a short pulse with no additional volume.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Three low-intensity points add readable spray highlights without introducing broad high-energy emission or washout.
proposals.acceptance_test: Glints remain smaller than the aircraft nose at capture resolution and do not merge into a bright strip in Ocean or Wide.

proposals.title: Layered tracer-to-splash cue
proposals.change: Add one short tracer segment ending in a compact water-splash spark cue at a distant impact point.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single thin warm tracer with a small pale-blue splash endpoint; keep both effects short, additive, and spatially separated from the aircraft hero.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Both components are tiny additive proxies with bounded extent, no dark smoke, and no broad sky or ocean coverage.
proposals.acceptance_test: The tracer and splash read as one distant event, occupy less than 5 percent of frame area combined, and preserve Ocean, Wide, City, and Combat usability.
